role.purpose: Masthead role line, set in signal. Uppercase.

lede.purpose: Opening paragraph of a ticket, max 38em.

body.purpose: Reading text with tabular numerals, max 42em.

label.purpose: Field labels on stubs, summary facts, form fields, table heads. Uppercase, reading face.

shadows.name: panel-rest
shadows.purpose: Legs, manifest tables, entry lists, repositories list.

shadows.name: live-halo

shadows.name: live-tick
shadows.purpose: Current leg tick on the experience rail.

shadows.name: arrive

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Every transition and the load moment (--ease-out).

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Colour, border and background state changes.

motion.name: route-draw
motion.purpose: Route line draws Klaten to Jakarta on load; only with JS and prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

motion.name: strike
motion.purpose: Jakarta marker strikes in as the line arrives.

motion.name: page-transition
motion.value: @view-transition navigation: auto; root 0.22s, masthead group 0.3s, ease-out
motion.purpose: CV and Portfolio cross-fade; the masthead holds (view-transition-name: masthead). prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference only.

motion.name: arrive
motion.value: box-shadow ring to 14px, 0.9s ease-out, 0.35s delay, 2 iterations
motion.purpose: Station marker pulse on :target. The target station name turns signal-ink in every motion setting.

motion.name: timeline-draw
motion.value: scaleY(0) to none 0.8s; markers scale(0.4) to none 0.35s, 0.16s stagger
motion.purpose: Portfolio troubleshooting line draws on scroll into view; gated by a .motion class set by JS only when IntersectionObserver exists and motion is allowed.

motion.name: status-in
motion.value: opacity 0 and translateY(3px) to none, 0.25s ease-out; fade-in under reduce
motion.purpose: Form status eases in as the response to Send.

themes.dark: night mixin: applied under prefers-color-scheme: dark on :root:not([data-theme="light"]), and on :root[data-theme="dark"]. Same custom property names; values are the night-* color keys. mast-ink takes night-ink; signal-hover takes night-signal-hover; --shadow-rest and --shadow-lift become white hairline rings (lift adds a dark drop). focus and on-signal are not redefined.
themes.print: stock, paper, mast to #fff; ink and mast-ink to #000; tickets, legs, passes, manifests and entries trade shadow for a 1px rule border; slots lose their tint.

narrative.overview:
The CV is an itinerary of record: a dated, confirmed route of legs from Klaten through Yogyakarta to Jakarta, printed on cool ticket stock, with the current leg struck forward in signal orange and stamped IN SERVICE. Every surface is a part of a travel document: a navy masthead band with a mono running head, a white route strip, ticket panels with perforated stubs, boarding passes for projects, manifest tables for skills and certifications.

The page is calm and dense in the way a timetable is dense: two inks on stock, condensed capitals for names and places, a plain reading face for everything a person reads, and mono reserved for the things a ticket would print by machine (dates, refs, codes). One continuous route line runs through the experience section and the route strip; stations are round markers on it. Depth is paper resting on stock, not floating cards.

Rejected by the world itself: cards with coloured side borders, gradients, glass. The build carries none of them.
keyCharacteristics: Two inks (navy ink, route blue) plus one live signal orange on cool stock.
Barlow Condensed caps for names, cities and titles; Source Sans 3 for reading and field labels; JetBrains Mono for dates, refs, codes only.
Dashed perforation rules separate ticket parts; punched notches where perforations meet edges.
One continuous 4px route line with round station markers.
Light and dark ("night") themes from the same token names; one authored motion moment (the route draw), with quiet continuity and feedback around it.

rules.name: The One Live State Rule
rules.body: Signal orange marks only what is current or what acts: the current leg, the current station, the active index item, the primary action, focus. Past legs are plain route blue. Nothing is orange for decoration.

rules.name: The Signal-Ink Rule
rules.body: Orange as text or stroke on paper or stock uses `signal-ink`, never `signal`. Fills use `signal` with `on-signal` text.

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: Navy ink and route blue on stock and paper. No gradients, no third accent hue.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Condensed caps for names, places and titles; Source Sans 3 for everything read, including field labels; JetBrains Mono only for dates, refs and codes. A label is never set in mono.

rules.name: The One Line Rule
rules.body: A single continuous route line governs the page: 4px of route blue, drawn across the route strip and down the experience rail. Stations are round markers on it; legs are small round ticks. Do not add a second line system.

rules.name: The Printed Panel Rule
rules.body: Panels rest on stock; they never float. Shadows are ambient and ink-tinted (a hairline ring at night), never hard offset, never coloured. Panels take `--shadow-rest` or `--shadow-lift`, never a literal shadow. Separation inside a panel is a perforation.

dos: Do reserve signal orange for the current state and the primary action (The One Live State Rule).
Do use `signal-ink` for orange text or strokes on paper and stock, and `on-signal` text on signal fills.
Do separate parts of a panel with 2px dashed perforation in `perf`, with stock-filled notches where it meets an edge.
Do set names, cities and titles in Barlow Condensed caps; dates, refs and codes in JetBrains Mono; everything else, labels included, in Source Sans 3.
Do keep every new colour decision paired: define the token on `:root` and its counterpart in the `night` mixin.
Do keep the route draw as the one authored motion moment; anything else is brief continuity or feedback, runs only under `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`, and never hides content by default.
donts: Don't use cards with coloured side borders, gradients or glass.
Don't add a second accent hue or a second route line.
Don't use hard offset shadows or coloured shadows on panels.
Don't set field labels or body text in mono.
Don't round panels beyond 3px; circles are for markers and notches only.
Don't stamp anything other than the current leg.
